series.name: SG2-8K G2 Premium (single-phase residential string 2-8kW)
series.notes: Codes are bare 3-digit integers on LCD/App, not E###. This is the older G2 Premium platform - it is the ONLY Sungrow line in this research that uses per-stage grid codes (002/015 = stage I/II over-voltage). Do NOT merge with sungrow-sg-rs (RS platform) or sungrow-sh: 002 means 'Grid over-voltage stage I' here but is grouped as a generic 'Grid Overvoltage' on RS/SH. 089 is a configuration warning, not a fault. Codes 501-514 are warning-class.

meaning.en: Grid voltage is above the inverter's first-level over-voltage trip point. The inverter stops exporting to protect itself and reconnects when the grid returns inside the window.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage inverter ke pehle over-voltage level se upar hai. Inverter apni himmat bachane ke liye band ho jata hai aur grid theek hone par dobara chalu hota hai.

causes.en: Grid voltage higher than the protective setting (heavy load on the feeder or high-tension line).
causes.ur: Grid voltage protective setting se zyada hai (feeder par load zyada ya HT line).

causes.en: Grid voltage inside range but AC cable/connection loose, causing a bad measurement.
causes.ur: Grid voltage range mein hai lekin AC cable ya connection loose hai, is liye reading kharab aa rahi hai.

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage with a multimeter at the inverter AC terminals and compare with the set over-voltage limit in iSolarCloud.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se inverter ke AC terminal par grid voltage check karein aur iSolarCloud ke set over-voltage limit se compare karein.

solutions.en: If the grid really is high, report it to the DISCO/grid company - do not change the protection setting yourself.
solutions.ur: Agar grid sach mein high hai to DISCO/grid company ko report karein - protection setting khud change na karein.

solutions.en: If grid voltage is normal, switch off the AC breaker, re-torque the AC terminal and re-check.
solutions.ur: Agar grid voltage normal hai to AC breaker off karke AC terminal dobara tighten karein aur check karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: A short grid spike pushed voltage above the inverter upper limit briefly. Usually clears by itself once the spike is gone.
meaning.ur: Grid mein short voltage spike aaya aur inverter limit se upar chala gaya. Zyada tar spike khatam hote hi khud clear ho jata hai.

causes.en: Large motor or transformer switched on nearby in the grid.
causes.ur: Grid par kareeb koi bada motor ya transformer chalu hua.

causes.en: Weak/unstable feeder causing rapid voltage swings.
causes.ur: Feeder kamzor ya unstable hai jis se voltage tezi se upar neeche ho raha hai.

solutions.en: Wait a few minutes for the inverter to recover on its own before touching anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch der intezaar karein, inverter apne aap theek ho jata hai, uske baad kuch mat chhune.

solutions.en: If it keeps repeating, log the grid voltage and peak time, then report to the utility company.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar ho raha hai to grid voltage aur waqt note karke utility company ko bata dein.

solutions.en: Check the AC main breaker and contactor for arcing, which can cause repeated spikes.
solutions.ur: AC main breaker aur contactor mein arcing to nahi, is liye unhein check karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: Grid voltage dropped below the first-level under-voltage threshold. The inverter disconnects and waits for the grid to come back.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage pehle under-voltage level se neeche gir gaya. Inverter disconnect ho jata hai aur grid aane ka intezaar karta hai.

causes.en: Long AC cable run causing voltage drop, especially on a lightly loaded feeder.
causes.ur: AC cable lambi hone se voltage drop, khaas kar jab feeder par load kam ho.

causes.en: Loose AC terminal or breaker not fully engaged.
causes.ur: AC terminal loose hai ya breaker poori tarah engage nahi hua.

causes.en: Grid outage or a very heavy local load dragging the voltage down.
causes.ur: Grid outage ya koi bohat bara local load voltage gira raha hai.

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage at the inverter terminals and at the distribution board, compare the two readings.
solutions.ur: Inverter terminal aur distribution board dono par grid voltage check karke dono readings compare karein.

solutions.en: Switch off the AC breaker and re-torque the AC terminal; check the breaker is fully snapped in.
solutions.ur: AC breaker off karke AC terminal tighten karein; check karein breaker poori tarah baith gaya hai.

solutions.en: If the feeder is genuinely weak, report it to the utility company rather than raising the trip value.
solutions.ur: Agar feeder sach mein kamzor hai to trip value barhane ke bajaye utility company ko report karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: A second, lower under-voltage threshold tripped - a deeper sag than code 004. Means the grid is well below normal for longer.
meaning.ur: Dusra aur neeche ka under-voltage level trigger hua - code 004 se zyada gehra voltage drop. Matlab grid ka voltage lambi der se normal se neeche hai.

causes.en: Sustained low voltage from an overloaded local transformer.
causes.ur: Local transformer overload hone se sustained low voltage.

causes.en: Poor AC connection adding extra voltage drop.
causes.ur: AC connection kharab hone se extra voltage drop.

solutions.en: Wait for the grid to recover; this fault is designed to clear automatically.
solutions.ur: Grid theek hone ka intezaar karein, ye fault khud ba khud clear hota hai.

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage; if it is within range, inspect and re-torque all AC terminals.
solutions.ur: Grid voltage check karein; range mein hai to tamam AC terminals check karke tighten karein.

solutions.en: If the fault persists after the grid is stable, contact Sungrow Service Dept.
solutions.ur: Grid theek hone ke baad bhi fault rahe to Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: AC output current exceeded the inverter's upper protection limit. The inverter restarts once current drops back into range.
meaning.ur: AC output current inverter ke protection limit se upar chala gaya. Current wapas normal hone par inverter restart ho jata hai.

causes.en: Parallel AC circuits with too much load on this one inverter.
causes.ur: Is ek inverter par bohat zyada load aur multiple parallel AC circuits.

causes.en: Partial paralleling of two inverters without correct communication settings.
causes.ur: Do inverters bina sahi communication setting ke parallel kiye gaye.

causes.en: Inverter internal current sensor or power stage degrading.
causes.ur: Inverter ka current sensor ya power stage kharab ho raha hai.

solutions.en: Confirm total connected AC load matches the inverter rating; reduce parallel load if over-subscribed.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke total AC load inverter ke rating ke mutabiq hai; zyada ho to parallel load kam karein.

solutions.en: Open the AC breaker, check the cable size, breaker rating and all AC connections.
solutions.ur: AC breaker khol kar cable size, breaker rating aur tamam AC connections check karein.

solutions.en: If load and connections are correct, let it retry; if it keeps happening, contact Sungrow Service Dept.
solutions.ur: Load aur connections sahi hain to dobara try karne dein; baar baar ho to Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: A brief AC current spike; the inverter self-recovers after several seconds without any action.
meaning.ur: AC current mein chhoti si tez spike. Inverter kuch second baad khud recover ho jata hai, koi action ki zarurat nahi.

causes.en: Inrush current from a large appliance starting on the same circuit.
causes.ur: Usi circuit par kisi bare appliance ka inrush current.

causes.en: Loose AC terminal momentarily arcing.
causes.ur: AC terminal loose hone se moment mein arcing.

solutions.en: Wait several seconds for automatic recovery - no reset needed.
solutions.ur: Kuch second wait karein, khud recover ho jayega - reset ki zarurat nahi.

solutions.en: If repeated, isolate large motor/AC loads and start them one at a time to find the trigger.
solutions.ur: Baar baar ho to bare motor/AC load alag karke ek ek karke on karein taake trigger pata chale.

solutions.en: Check and re-torque all AC terminals if the code appears at random times.
solutions.ur: Agar code bina wajah aata hai to tamam AC terminals check karke tighten karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: Grid frequency rose above the first-level over-frequency trip value, so the inverter stopped exporting.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency pehle over-frequency level se upar chali gayi, is liye inverter ne export band kar diya.

causes.en: Grid frequency genuinely above the permitted band (generator-backed supply or overloaded genset).
causes.ur: Grid frequency asal mein permitted range se upar hai (generator par supply ya overloaded genset).

causes.en: Frequency protection parameter set too tight for local conditions.
causes.ur: Frequency protection parameter local conditions ke liye bohat tight rakha gaya hai.

solutions.en: Check the actual grid frequency; 50 Hz nominal with a small allowed band.
solutions.ur: Asli grid frequency check karein; nominal 50 Hz hai aur thoda hi tolerance hota hai.

solutions.en: If frequency is out of band, ask the utility/genset owner to correct it.
solutions.ur: Agar frequency range se bahar hai to utility ya genset owner se theek karwane ka request karein.

solutions.en: If frequency is in band, contact Sungrow Service Dept rather than loosening protection.
solutions.ur: Agar frequency range mein hai to protection loosen karne ke bajaye Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: Grid frequency fell below the first-level under-frequency trip value; the inverter waited for the grid to stabilise.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency pehle under-frequency level se neeche gir gayi; inverter ne grid theek hone ka intezaar kiya.

causes.en: Small overloaded diesel generator unable to hold 50 Hz.
causes.ur: Chhota overloaded diesel generator 50 Hz par nahi tikka.

causes.en: Large motor starting on the grid pulling frequency down.
causes.ur: Grid par koi bada motor start hokar frequency gira raha hai.

solutions.en: Measure grid frequency with a multimeter or clamp meter and log the value.
solutions.ur: Multimeter ya clamp meter se grid frequency check karke value note karein.

solutions.en: If a generator is involved, reduce its load or let the generator governor settle, then restart.
solutions.ur: Agar generator involved hai to uska load kam karein ya governor ko settle hone dein, phir restart karein.

solutions.en: If frequency is inside the range, contact Sungrow Service Dept.
solutions.ur: Agar frequency range mein hai to Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: The inverter lost the reference from the grid and stopped to avoid back-feeding a dead line. This is also the normal anti-islanding trip during a grid outage.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne grid ka reference kho diya aur dead line mein power wapas bhejne se bachne ke liye band ho gaya. Grid outage ke waqt ye normal anti-islanding trip hai.

causes.en: Actual grid outage or the AC circuit breaker has tripped.
causes.ur: Asli grid outage ya AC circuit breaker trip ho gaya.

causes.en: AC cables loose or not fully seated in the terminal block.
causes.ur: AC cables loose hain ya terminal block mein poori tarah baithi nahi.

causes.en: Grid is not in service for maintenance.
causes.ur: Grid maintenance ke liye service mein hai.

solutions.en: Check whether the AC circuit breaker has tripped and reset it if the grid is live.
solutions.ur: Check karein AC circuit breaker trip to nahi hua; grid live ho to reset karein.

solutions.en: Switch the AC breaker off, confirm every AC cable terminal is tight, then switch back on.
solutions.ur: AC breaker off karein, har AC cable terminal tight check karein, phir wapas on karein.

solutions.en: If all connections are fine and the LCD still shows 010, ask the utility to confirm supply status.
solutions.ur: Agar connections sab sahi hain aur LCD par ab bhi 010 hai to utility se supply status confirm karwane ko kahen.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: DC current being injected onto the AC side exceeded the upper limit. The inverter stops export to protect the grid.
meaning.ur: AC side par DC current ka injection upper limit se upar chala gaya. Inverter ne grid bachane ke liye export band kar diya.

causes.en: Unusual equipment on the same AC circuit injecting DC (bad charger, welder, LED driver).
causes.ur: Usi AC circuit par DC inject karne wala koi ajeeb equipment (kharab charger, welder, LED driver).

causes.en: Internal inverter measurement or switching stage fault.
causes.ur: Inverter ka apna measurement ya switching stage fault.

solutions.en: Wait a moment for the inverter to recover on its own.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke khud recover hone ka thoda intezaar karein.

solutions.en: If repeated, isolate other AC loads one by one to find the equipment injecting DC.
solutions.ur: Baar baar ho to doosre AC load ek ek karke alag karein taake DC inject karne wala equipment pakde.

solutions.en: Contact Sungrow Service Dept if the fault occurs repeatedly with no external cause.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar ho aur bahar se koi waja nahi to Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: Insulation leakage current from the PV strings or AC side exceeded the inverter limit, so it shut down to avoid electric shock.
meaning.ur: PV strings ya AC side se leakage current inverter ke limit se upar chala gaya, is liye electric shock se bachne ke liye band ho gaya.

causes.en: Moisture on PV modules, connectors or DC cables after rain, fog or heavy dew.
causes.ur: Baarish, dhund ya oos par PV module, connector ya DC cable geela ho jana.

causes.en: Damaged module insulation or a chafed DC cable touching the frame.
causes.ur: Module ki insulation kharab ya DC cable par layer ukhad kar frame ko chhu raha hai.

causes.en: Water ingress into the AC terminal box or conduit.
causes.ur: AC terminal box ya conduit mein paas jaana.

solutions.en: Open the DC switch, then test each string to earth with a megohmmeter/insulation tester while PV is fully off.
solutions.ur: DC switch off karein, phir PV poori tarah band kar ke har string ko earth ke khilaf insulation tester se test karein.

solutions.en: Dry the connectors and cables, re-terminate any wet MC4 pair, and re-test.
solutions.ur: Connector aur cable sukha lein, geele MC4 pair dobara baithayein, phir dobara test karein.

solutions.en: Inspect module backs for cracks or water ingress and replace the affected module or DC cable.
solutions.ur: Module ke peeche crack ya paas jaana check karein aur woh module ya DC cable badal dein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

title.ur: 10 minute ka average grid voltage zyada (014)

meaning.en: The average grid voltage over 10 minutes stayed above the permitted range, so the inverter locked out to protect the grid.
meaning.ur: 10 minute ka average grid voltage permitted range se upar raha, is liye inverter ne grid bachane ke liye lock out kar diya.

causes.en: Sustained high grid voltage from a heavily loaded daytime feeder.
causes.ur: Din mein feeder zyada load hone se sustained high grid voltage.

causes.en: Wrong country/grid code selected, so the protection window is wrong for Pakistan.
causes.ur: Galat country ya grid code select hua hai, is liye Pakistan ke liye protection window ghalat hai.

solutions.en: Check the country code selected in the inverter matches the actual country of installation.
solutions.ur: Check karein inverter ka country code installation ke asli mulk ke mutabiq hai.

solutions.en: Wait a moment; the inverter will retry once the 10-minute average returns in range.
solutions.ur: Thoda intezaar karein; 10 minute ka average range mein aate hi inverter dobara try karega.

solutions.en: If the average is genuinely high, report to the utility company - do not widen the window yourself.
solutions.ur: Agar average sach mein high hai to utility company ko bata dein - window khud bara na karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: The second, higher over-voltage threshold tripped - a worse excursion than code 002. A deliberate safety lockout.
meaning.ur: Dusra aur zyada high over-voltage level trigger hua - code 002 se zyada sakht violation. Ye jaan boojh kar lagaya hua safety lockout hai.

causes.en: AC cable undersized for the distance, so its voltage drop is being read as a high grid voltage.
causes.ur: AC cable distance ke liye chhoti hai, is liye uska voltage drop high grid voltage ki tarah read hota hai.

causes.en: Grid voltage genuinely beyond the permissible range (stage II limit).
causes.ur: Grid voltage asal mein permissible range se bahar hai (stage II limit).

solutions.en: Confirm the AC cable model/size is appropriate for the run length; upgrade undersized AC cable.
solutions.ur: Check karein AC cable ka size run length ke liye sahi hai; chhoti AC cable barhi badal dein.

solutions.en: Wait for the inverter to recover once the grid settles.
solutions.ur: Grid theek hone par inverter ko recover hone dein.

solutions.en: If the grid is beyond the permissible range, ask the utility grid company to fix it.
solutions.ur: Agar grid permissible range se bahar hai to utility grid company se theek karwane ko kahen.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: The internal DC bus voltage or bus power reached the high limit. The inverter stops to protect the boost stage.
meaning.ur: Internal DC bus voltage ya bus power high limit tak pohanch gaya. Inverter ne boost stage bachane ke liye band ho gaya.

causes.en: AC grid loss while PV keeps feeding, so power piles up in the bus.
causes.ur: AC grid chala gaya lekin PV power deta raha, is liye bus mein power jama ho gaya.

causes.en: Bus voltage sensing drift or an over-voltage in the internal DC link.
causes.ur: Bus voltage sensing mein ghalti ya internal DC link mein over-voltage.

solutions.en: Wait a moment for the inverter to recover on its own.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke apne aap theek hone ka thoda intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Check grid stability and AC connection; a flapping grid is the usual trigger.
solutions.ur: Grid stability aur AC connection check karein; grid ka chalna-phirna hi asal wajah hai.

solutions.en: If the fault occurs repeatedly, contact Sungrow Service Dept.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar ho raha hai to Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: A short spike pushed the internal bus voltage above the allowable upper limit. Normally clears itself.
meaning.ur: Ek chhota spike ne internal bus voltage allowable limit se upar le gaya. Aam tor par khud clear hota hai.

causes.en: Grid switching transient passing through to the DC bus.
causes.ur: Grid switching ka transient DC bus tak chala gaya.

causes.en: Weak PV string connection causing intermittent current steps.
causes.ur: PV string ka connection kamzor, is liye current baar baar badal raha hai.

solutions.en: Wait for automatic recovery before intervening.
solutions.ur: Kuch nahi chhune, khud recover hone dein.

solutions.en: Inspect and tighten all DC string terminals and MC4 connectors.
solutions.ur: Tamam DC string terminals aur MC4 connectors check karke tighten karein.

solutions.en: Contact Sungrow Service Dept if the fault occurs repeatedly.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar ho to Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: The internal DC bus voltage exceeded the protective value, so the inverter shut down the power stage.
meaning.ur: Internal DC bus voltage protective value se upar chala gaya, is liye inverter ne power stage band kar di.

causes.en: Grid disconnected while the inverter is back-feeding into the bus.
causes.ur: Grid disconnect ho gaya jab inverter bus mein power back-feed kar raha tha.

causes.en: Inverter internal boost circuit or bus voltage feedback fault.
causes.ur: Inverter ka internal boost circuit ya bus voltage feedback fault.

solutions.en: Wait a moment for the inverter to recover; the bus needs to discharge first.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke recover hone ka intezaar karein; pehle bus discharge hona zaruri hai.

solutions.en: Check the AC breaker, anti-islanding relay and grid supply stability.
solutions.ur: AC breaker, anti-islanding relay aur grid supply stability check karein.

solutions.en: Contact Sungrow Service Dept if the fault occurs repeatedly.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar ho to Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: Over-current detected on the PV1 MPPT input. Inspect the layout and wiring of that input.
meaning.ur: PV1 MPPT input par over-current detect hua. Us input ki wiring aur layout check karein.

causes.en: String current above the MPPT input rating - too many modules in parallel on that MPPT.
causes.ur: String current MPPT input rating se upar hai - us MPPT par bohat zyada modules parallel hain.

causes.en: PV cable pinched, crushed or shorted to earth.
causes.ur: PV cable dab gai, kuchal gayi ya earth se short ho gayi.

solutions.en: Turn the DC switch OFF, wait 10 minutes, then recount the modules on PV1 against the manual's per-MPPT string limit.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF karein, 10 minute wait karein, phir PV1 ke modules dohrayein aur manual ki per-MPPT string limit se compare karein.

solutions.en: Measure PV1 string open-circuit voltage and short-circuit current and compare with the datasheet.
solutions.ur: PV1 string ka open-circuit voltage aur short-circuit current naalein aur datasheet se compare karein.

solutions.en: Re-inspect PV1 cable routing for chafing or a crushed conduit and replace the damaged cable.
solutions.ur: PV1 cable ki routing dobara dekhein, kuchal ya damage ho to cable badal dein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: Over-current detected on the PV2 MPPT input. Inspect the layout and wiring of that input.
meaning.ur: PV2 MPPT input par over-current detect hua. Us input ki wiring aur layout check karein.

causes.en: String current above the PV2 MPPT input rating.
causes.ur: String current PV2 MPPT input rating se upar hai.

causes.en: PV2 cable crushed, chafed or shorted to earth.
causes.ur: PV2 cable dab gai, kuchal gayi ya earth se short ho gayi.

solutions.en: Turn the DC switch OFF, wait 10 minutes, then verify the PV2 string current against the datasheet.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF karein, 10 minute wait karein, phir PV2 string current datasheet se verify karein.

solutions.en: Check PV2 string polarity, MC4 seating and the DC fuse in that string.
solutions.ur: PV2 string polarity, MC4 ki seating aur us string ka DC fuse check karein.

solutions.en: Replace any PV2 cable with damaged insulation and re-test.
solutions.ur: PV2 ki kharab insulation wali cable badal ke dobara test karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: PV1 string is connected in reverse polarity. Do not work on it while current is flowing.
meaning.ur: PV1 string ulta polarity se lagi hai. Current flowing hone ke dauraan is par kaam na karein.

causes.en: MC4 connector on the PV1 string was crimped backwards.
causes.ur: PV1 string ka MC4 connector ulta crimp ho gaya.

causes.en: Installer swapped the string cables at the inverter DC input.
causes.ur: Installer ne inverter DC input par string cables aapas mein badal diye.

solutions.en: Rotate the DC switch to OFF, wait at least 10 minutes, and confirm PV current has dropped below 0.5 A.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF karein, kam az kam 10 minute wait karein, aur confirm karein PV current 0.5 A se neeche aa gaya hai.

solutions.en: Check the cable connections of PV1 and re-terminate the connector in the correct polarity.
solutions.ur: PV1 ke cable connections check karein aur connector sahi polarity mein dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Verify PV1 string voltage with a meter after reconnecting, then re-enable the DC switch.
solutions.ur: Dobara jodne ke baad meter se PV1 string voltage verify karein, phir DC switch wapas on karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: PV2 string is connected in reverse polarity. Do not work on it while current is flowing.
meaning.ur: PV2 string ulta polarity se lagi hai. Current flowing hone ke dauraan is par kaam na karein.

causes.en: MC4 connector on the PV2 string was crimped backwards.
causes.ur: PV2 string ka MC4 connector ulta crimp ho gaya.

causes.en: Installer swapped the string cables at the inverter DC input.
causes.ur: Installer ne inverter DC input par string cables aapas mein badal diye.

solutions.en: Rotate the DC switch to OFF, wait at least 10 minutes, and confirm PV current has dropped below 0.5 A.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF karein, kam az kam 10 minute wait karein, aur confirm karein PV current 0.5 A se neeche aa gaya hai.

solutions.en: Check the cable connections of PV2 and re-terminate the connector in the correct polarity.
solutions.ur: PV2 ke cable connections check karein aur connector sahi polarity mein dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Verify PV2 string voltage with a meter after reconnecting, then re-enable the DC switch.
solutions.ur: Dobara jodne ke baad meter se PV2 string voltage verify karein, phir DC switch wapas on karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: The heatsink (radiator) temperature reached the high limit, so the inverter derated or stopped to protect the power devices.
meaning.ur: Heatsink (radiator) ka temperature high limit tak pohanch gaya, is liye inverter ne power device bachane ke liye power kam ki ya band kar diya.

causes.en: Very high ambient temperature at the install location.
causes.ur: Install jagah ka ambient temperature bohat zyada hai.

causes.en: No airflow around the unit - mounted inside a closed cabinet or tight roof void.
causes.ur: Unit ke aas paas airflow nahi - band cabinet ya ghar ke andar laga hai.

causes.en: Direct sunlight on the heatsink.
causes.ur: Heatsink par seedhi dhoop aa rahi hai.

solutions.en: Read the ambient temperature shown on the screen and wait for it to fall below the trip value.
solutions.ur: Screen par dikhne wala ambient temperature parhein aur use trip value se neeche girne dein.

solutions.en: Clear at least the manufacturer's clearance around the unit for convection and clean the air inlets.
solutions.ur: Unit ke aas paas manufacturer ki maangi hui jagah saaf karein taake convection ho sake, aur air inlets saaf karein.

solutions.en: Install a shade over the unit if it is in direct sunlight.
solutions.ur: Agar unit seedhi dhoop mein hai to us ke upar shade lagayein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: Inverter internal temperature exceeded the limit. Usually a ventilation or fan problem rather than a sensor problem.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka internal temperature limit se upar chala gaya. Aam tor par ye sensor nahi, ventilation ya fan ki kami hoti hai.

causes.en: Cooling fan stopped, seized or clogged with dust.
causes.ur: Cooling fan band, jam ya dhool se block ho gaya.

causes.en: No convective space around the cabinet in a hot enclosed room.
causes.ur: Garam band kamre mein cabinet ke aas paas convection ki jagah nahi.

causes.en: Direct sunlight heating the enclosure beyond its rating.
causes.ur: Seedhi dhoop se enclosure rating se zyada garam ho raha hai.

solutions.en: Check the ambient temperature on screen, then confirm there is enough space for convection around the unit.
solutions.ur: Screen par ambient temperature dekhein, phir confirm karein unit ke aas paas convection ke liye jagah hai.

solutions.en: Check whether the inverter is in direct sunlight and shield it with a proper sunshade if so.
solutions.ur: Check karein unit seedhi dhoop mein hai ya nahi; ho to proper sunshade lagayein.

solutions.en: Check the fan is spinning; clean the air inlets and replace the fan if it is not turning.
solutions.ur: Check karein fan ghoom raha hai; air inlets saaf karein aur fan na ghoome to badal dein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: The grid-side relay failed to switch as commanded, so the inverter cannot safely connect or disconnect.
meaning.ur: Grid side relay ne command ke mutabiq switch nahi kiya, is liye inverter mehfooz taur par connect ya disconnect nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: Relay contacts welded or burnt from repeated switching or a surge.
causes.ur: Baar baar switching ya surge se relay ke contact jale ya chipak gaye.

causes.en: Relay coil or its 24 V control supply failed.
causes.ur: Relay coil ya uska 24 V control supply kharab ho gaya.

solutions.en: Wait a moment for the inverter to retry the relay operation.
solutions.ur: Inverter ko relay operation dobara karne ka thoda intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV first, then have a technician check the relay and the 24 V coil supply with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Pehle AC aur PV isolate karein, phir technician relay aur 24 V coil supply ko multimeter se check kare.

solutions.en: If the fault occurs repeatedly, contact Sungrow Service Dept for a service exchange.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar ho to Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein taake service exchange ho sake.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

title.ur: PV se earth ki insulation kam (ISO-flt) (039)

meaning.en: Insulation resistance between the PV array and earth fell too low, so the inverter stopped to avoid shock.
meaning.ur: PV array aur earth ke darmiyan insulation resistance bohat kam ho gaya, is liye shock se bachne ke liye inverter band ho gaya.

causes.en: One PV string shorted to earth, often through a damaged or wet module.
causes.ur: Ek PV string earth se short ho gaya, aksar kharab ya geele module ke zariye.

causes.en: No reliable inverter grounding line, so Riso reads low by mistake.
causes.ur: Inverter ki grounding line reliable nahi, is liye Riso ghalat low reading deta hai.

causes.en: DC cable chafed against the mounting frame or a sharp roof edge.
causes.ur: DC cable mounting frame ya roof ke sharp corner par kuchal gayi hai.

solutions.en: Confirm there is a reliable inverter grounding line to earth first; a weak earth causes false 039.
solutions.ur: Pehle confirm karein inverter ki earth line reliable hai; kamzor earth se jhalat 039 aata hai.

solutions.en: Turn the DC switch OFF, wait 10 minutes, then find the faulty string with an insulation tester, string by string.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF karein, 10 minute wait karein, phir insulation tester se ek ek string test kar ke kharab string dhoondein.

solutions.en: Replace the damaged module or DC cable section, or re-seal the connector, then clear the fault from the App.
solutions.ur: Kharab module ya DC cable ka hissa badal dein ya connector dobara seal karein, phir App se fault clear karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: The leakage current sensor circuit inside the inverter reported a fault, so the safety function is no longer trusted.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke andar ka leakage current sensor circuit fault batata hai, is liye safety function par bharosa nahi.

causes.en: Internal leakage sensor or its wiring harness loose or damaged.
causes.ur: Internal leakage sensor ya uski wiring harness loose ya kharab.

causes.en: Moisture or condensation on the internal sensing board.
causes.ur: Internal sensing board par namki ya condensation.

solutions.en: Wait a moment for the inverter to recover on its own before any physical check.
solutions.ur: Koi physical check karne se pehle thoda intezaar karein, inverter khud recover ho sakta hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, open the unit only if trained, and check the internal harness connectors are seated.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karein, sirf trained person unit khole, aur internal harness connectors baithay huay check karein.

solutions.en: If the fault occurs repeatedly, contact Sungrow Service Dept for a unit exchange.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar ho to Sungrow Service Dept se unit exchange ke liye rabta karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: Ambient temperature inside the inverter fell below the low limit. The inverter restarts by itself once it warms up past -25 degC.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke andar ka ambient temperature low limit se neeche gir gaya. -25 degC se upar hone par inverter khud restart ho jata hai.

causes.en: Night-time or winter ambient temperature below the operating range (Pakistan winter nights).
causes.ur: Raat ya sarmay ka ambient temperature operating range se neeche (Pakistan ki sarmay ki raatein).

causes.en: Unit installed in an unheated store room or exposed lobby overnight.
causes.ur: Unit bina heating ke store room ya khule lobby mein lage hai.

solutions.en: No action needed - the inverter recovers once the ambient temperature rises above -25 degC.
solutions.ur: Koi action nahi chahiye - ambient temperature -25 degC se upar hote hi inverter recover ho jata hai.

solutions.en: If the site regularly goes below the limit, note it and advise the customer or move the unit to a warmer, enclosed spot.
solutions.ur: Agar site par baar baar limit se neeche jata hai to customer ko bata dein ya unit ko garm jagah move kar dein.

solutions.en: Avoid placing heaters directly against the unit to warm it - this can trip the over-temperature fault 037.
solutions.ur: Garm karne ke liye heater ko seedha unit ke saath mat lagayein - is se 037 over-temperature fault aa sakta hai.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: The inverter's internal power-on self-test did not complete successfully.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka power-on self-test safaltay se mukammal nahi hua.

causes.en: Unstable AC or DC supply during power-up, or brown-out on the grid.
causes.ur: Power-on ke waqt AC ya DC supply unstable, ya grid par brown-out.

causes.en: Internal control board or firmware boot problem.
causes.ur: Internal control board ya firmware boot mein masla.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, wait the full 10 minutes for capacitors to discharge, then power up once on clean supplies.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karein, capacitors discharge hone ke liye poore 10 minute wait karein, phir saaf supply par ek baar power up karein.

solutions.en: Check the DC switch and AC breaker are fully engaged and not tripping during start-up.
solutions.ur: Check karein DC switch aur AC breaker poori tarah lage hain aur start-up par trip nahi ho rahe.

solutions.en: Contact Sungrow Service Dept if the self-test fault survives a clean restart.
solutions.ur: Agar saaf restart ke baad bhi self-test fault rahe to Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: The boost converter stage connected to PV1 reported a fault.
meaning.ur: PV1 se juda boost converter stage ne fault report kiya.

causes.en: PV1 string over-voltage or a switching device in the boost stage failed.
causes.ur: PV1 string par over-voltage ya boost stage ka switching device kharab.

causes.en: Severe earlier surge or overheating damage in the boost stage.
causes.ur: Pehle koi sakht surge ya over-garmi se boost stage nuksan ho gaya.

solutions.en: Wait a moment for the inverter to recover before touching the DC side.
solutions.ur: DC side chhune se pehle thoda intezaar karein, inverter recover ho sakta hai.

solutions.en: Turn the DC switch OFF, wait 10 minutes, and measure PV1 open-circuit voltage against the maximum input rating.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF karein, 10 minute wait karein, aur PV1 ka open-circuit voltage maximum input rating se compare karein.

solutions.en: If the fault occurs repeatedly, contact Sungrow Service Dept - the boost stage is a service item.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar ho to Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein - boost stage service item hai.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: The boost converter stage connected to PV2 reported a fault.
meaning.ur: PV2 se juda boost converter stage ne fault report kiya.

causes.en: PV2 string over-voltage or a switching device in the boost stage failed.
causes.ur: PV2 string par over-voltage ya boost stage ka switching device kharab.

causes.en: Severe earlier surge or overheating damage in the boost stage.
causes.ur: Pehle koi sakht surge ya over-garmi se boost stage nuksan ho gaya.

solutions.en: Wait a moment for the inverter to recover before touching the DC side.
solutions.ur: DC side chhune se pehle thoda intezaar karein, inverter recover ho sakta hai.

solutions.en: Turn the DC switch OFF, wait 10 minutes, and measure PV2 open-circuit voltage against the maximum input rating.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF karein, 10 minute wait karein, aur PV2 ka open-circuit voltage maximum input rating se compare karein.

solutions.en: If the fault occurs repeatedly, contact Sungrow Service Dept - the boost stage is a service item.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar ho to Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein - boost stage service item hai.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: The inverter's phase current sensing channel reported an inconsistent or failed reading.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka phase current sensing channel galat ya failed reading de raha hai.

causes.en: Current sensor or its hall-effect device damaged, often by heat or a surge.
causes.ur: Current sensor ya uska hall-effect device garmi ya surge se kharab.

causes.en: Sensor harness connector loose inside the inverter.
causes.ur: Sensor ka harness connector inverter ke andar loose.

solutions.en: Wait a moment for the inverter to recover - the check will reset the sampling channel.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke recover hone ka intezaar karein - check sampling channel reset kar deta hai.

solutions.en: Cross-check the reported power against the iSolarCloud data and a clamp meter on the AC output.
solutions.ur: iSolarCloud data aur AC output par clamp meter se reported power ki cross-check karein.

solutions.en: Contact Sungrow Service Dept if the fault repeats; a bad current sensor is not a field-repairable part.
solutions.ur: Agar fault dobara aaye to Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein; kharab current sensor field mein theek nahi hota.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

title.ur: Slave DSP ne grid over-voltage detect kiya (053)

meaning.en: The secondary (slave) DSP controller saw a grid voltage above the allowable limit - the two control boards disagreed with the main reading.
meaning.ur: Secondary (slave) DSP controller ne grid voltage limit se upar dekhi - dono control boards ki main reading se ikhtiyalaf tha.

causes.en: Genuine grid voltage above the inverter allowable upper limit.
causes.ur: Grid voltage asal mein inverter ke upper limit se upar hai.

causes.en: Measurement disagreement between the two DSPs caused by a drifting sensing board.
causes.ur: Sensing board ke ghalat hone se dono DSP ki measurement mein ikhtiyalaf.

solutions.en: Check the grid voltage; if it is above the permissible range, ask the utility grid company for a solution.
solutions.ur: Grid voltage check karein; permissible range se upar ho to utility grid company se hal manga dein.

solutions.en: If the grid voltage is within the permissible range, contact Sungrow Service Dept.
solutions.ur: Agar grid voltage permissible range mein hai to Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein.

solutions.en: Re-seat and check the AC connection while isolated, as a loose terminal can make the two boards read differently.
solutions.ur: Isolate karte hue AC connection dobara check aur tighten karein, kyun ke loose terminal se dono boards ka read alag hota hai.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

title.ur: Slave DSP ne grid over-frequency detect kiya (054)

meaning.en: The secondary DSP controller saw a grid frequency above the allowable limit.
meaning.ur: Secondary DSP controller ne grid frequency allowable limit se upar dekhi.

causes.en: Genuine grid frequency above the inverter allowable upper limit.
causes.ur: Grid frequency asal mein inverter ke allowable upper limit se upar hai.

causes.en: Frequency reference or sensing drift in the slave control board.
causes.ur: Slave control board mein frequency reference ya sensing ki ghalti.

solutions.en: Check the grid frequency; if it is above the permissible range, ask the utility grid company for a solution.
solutions.ur: Grid frequency check karein; permissible range se upar ho to utility grid company se hal manga dein.

solutions.en: If the grid frequency is within the permissible range, contact Sungrow Service Dept.
solutions.ur: Agar grid frequency permissible range mein hai to Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein.

solutions.en: Check the frequency protection settings in iSolarCloud match the local grid standard.
solutions.ur: iSolarCloud mein frequency protection settings local grid standard ke mutabiq hain ya nahi check karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

title.ur: Slave DSP ne leakage current zyada detect kiya (056)

meaning.en: The secondary DSP saw leakage current above the inverter's allowable upper limit, usually a real PV ground fault.
meaning.ur: Secondary DSP ne leakage current inverter ke upper limit se upar dekha, aam tor par ye asal mein PV ka ground fault hota hai.

causes.en: A grounded fault on the PV string - damaged, wet or poorly terminated module.
causes.ur: PV string par grounded fault - kharab, geela ya ghulmi se baitha hua module.

causes.en: DC cable insulation broken by a sharp roof edge or conduit.
causes.ur: DC cable ki insulation sharp roof edge ya conduit se kuchal kar tooti hai.

solutions.en: Turn the DC switch OFF, wait 10 minutes, then locate the grounded string with an insulation tester.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF karein, 10 minute wait karein, phir insulation tester se grounded string dhoondein.

solutions.en: Check the inverter grounding line, then repair the damaged module, connector or DC cable section.
solutions.ur: Inverter ki grounding line check karein, phir kharab module, connector ya DC cable ka hissa theek karein.

solutions.en: If the error occurs repeatedly, contact Sungrow Service Dept.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar aaye to Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: The two internal DSP control boards could not talk to each other, so redundant protection is inactive.
meaning.ur: Do internal DSP control boards aapas mein baat nahi kar paye, is liye redundant protection inactive hai.

causes.en: Internal control harness connector loose, or a previous power event damaged the boards.
causes.ur: Internal control harness connector loose, ya pichhli power event se boards nuksaan hue.

causes.en: One DSP board has failed outright.
causes.ur: Ek DSP board poora fail ho gaya.

solutions.en: Wait 1 minute for the inverter to recover - the boards retry the handshake.
solutions.ur: 1 minute intezaar karein, boards dobara handshake karte hain.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then have a technician reseat the internal DSP harness and check the 24 V rail.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karein, phir technician internal DSP harness dobara baithaye aur 24 V rail check kare.

solutions.en: If the fault persists, contact Sungrow Service Dept.
solutions.ur: Agar fault rahe to Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: The inverter type parameter has not been configured, so the unit has not been fully commissioned and will not work correctly.
meaning.ur: Inverter type parameter configure nahi hua, is liye unit poori tarah commission nahi hua aur theek se kaam nahi karega.

causes.en: Commissioning steps were skipped after installation or a firmware update.
causes.ur: Installation ya firmware update ke baad commissioning ke steps chhoot gaye.

causes.en: Parameter memory cleared or corrupted.
causes.ur: Parameter memory clear ya corrupt ho gaya.

solutions.en: Set the inverter type in iSolarCloud or the LCD commissioning menu before anything else.
solutions.ur: Sab se pehle iSolarCloud ya LCD commissioning menu mein inverter type set karein.

solutions.en: Then complete the remaining commissioning items: country code, grid parameters and communication.
solutions.ur: Phir baqi commissioning poora karein: country code, grid parameters aur communication.

solutions.en: Contact Sungrow Service Dept if the parameter will not save.
solutions.ur: Agar parameter save nahi hota to Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: The inverter's cooling fans have failed. Forced shutdown follows because the unit can no longer control its temperature.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke cooling fan kharab ho gaye. Is liye zabardasti shutdown, kyun ke ab unit temperature control nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: Fan motor bearing worn or the fan blades blocked by dust and debris.
causes.ur: Fan motor ka bearing ghis gaya ya fan ki blades dhool se block ho gayi.

causes.en: Fan duct obstructed or the fan cable disconnected.
causes.ur: Fan duct band hai ya fan ka cable nikal gaya.

solutions.en: Stop the inverter, disconnect the AC and DC cables, and wait 10 minutes before opening anything.
solutions.ur: Inverter band karein, AC aur DC cables disconnect karein, aur kuch kholne se pehle 10 minute wait karein.

solutions.en: Check whether the fan duct is blocked and clear any dust or foreign material.
solutions.ur: Check karein fan duct block to nahi aur dhool ya bahri cheez hata dein.

solutions.en: If the duct is clear, replace the fan(s) with the correct model.
solutions.ur: Agar duct saaf hai to sahi model ke fan badal dein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

title.ur: Sungrow Meter ulta jone ka warning (084)

meaning.en: The export/import meter current direction is reversed, so readings will be wrong. Generation usually continues.
meaning.ur: Export/import meter ka current direction ulta hai, is liye readings ghalat hongi. Generation aam tor par chalti rehti hai.

causes.en: Meter power cable connections incorrect, or the CT clamp mounted the wrong way round.
causes.ur: Meter ke power cable connections ghalat, ya CT clamp ulta lagaya gaya.

causes.en: 'Existing Inverter' feature switched on without setting the existing inverter's rated power correctly.
causes.ur: 'Existing Inverter' feature on kiya gaya lekin us inverter ki rated power sahi set nahi ki.

solutions.en: Check whether the power cable connections to the meter are correct and re-terminate them.
solutions.ur: Check karein meter ke power cable connections sahi hain aur unhein dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: If 'Existing Inverter' is set to ON in the LCD menu, verify the existing inverter's rated power value is set correctly.
solutions.ur: Agar LCD menu mein 'Existing Inverter' ON hai to us inverter ki rated power value sahi set hai ya nahi check karein.

solutions.en: For a Sungrow single-phase meter, confirm the 1-phase sensor's CT clamp is clipped in the correct direction on the live conductor.
solutions.ur: Sungrow single-phase meter ke liye confirm karein 1-phase sensor ka CT clamp live conductor par sahi direction mein laga hai.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: Internal boards are running different firmware versions, which can break the control handshake.
meaning.ur: Internal boards alag alag firmware version par chal rahe hain, is liye control handshake bigad sakta hai.

causes.en: A firmware update was interrupted or only partly applied.
causes.ur: Firmware update adhoora reh gaya ya sirf aadha apply hua.

causes.en: A board was replaced with a different revision without reflash.
causes.ur: Board badla gaya lekin us par firmware dobara nahi daala gaya.

solutions.en: Check the firmware version shown under Device Info for every internal board and note any mismatch.
solutions.ur: Device Info mein har internal board ka firmware version dekhein aur koi bhi mismatch note karein.

solutions.en: Do a full power cycle: isolate AC and PV, wait 10 minutes, then restore and allow the update to finish.
solutions.ur: Poora power cycle karein: AC aur PV isolate karein, 10 minute wait karein, phir wapas on karke update poora hone dein.

solutions.en: Contact Sungrow Service Dept to obtain and flash the correct matched firmware package.
solutions.ur: Sahi matched firmware package lene ke liye Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: The internal AFCI (arc fault detection) module itself is not working, so arc protection is unavailable.
meaning.ur: Internal AFCI (arc fault detection) module khud kaam nahi kar raha, is liye arc protection available nahi hai.

causes.en: AFCI module connector loose or the module has failed.
causes.ur: AFCI module ka connector loose hai ya module fail ho gaya.

causes.en: Supply voltage to the AFCI module out of specification.
causes.ur: AFCI module ko milne wala supply voltage spec ke bahar hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, wait 10 minutes, then have a technician check the AFCI module seating and its supply.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karein, 10 minute wait karein, phir technician AFCI module ki seating aur supply check kare.

solutions.en: Contact Sungrow Service Dept for the replacement AFCI module.
solutions.ur: Replacement AFCI module ke liye Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein.

solutions.en: Until the module is fixed, treat the PV side as unprotected for arc faults and inspect connectors regularly.
solutions.ur: Module theek hone tak PV side ko arc fault se unprotected samajhein aur connectors regularly check karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: The AFCI detected a series or parallel arc in the PV DC wiring. A real fire risk - treat this as urgent.
meaning.ur: AFCI ne PV DC wiring mein series ya parallel arc detect kiya. Ye asli fire risk hai - ise fori samajhein.

causes.en: Loose, damaged or poorly crimped MC4 connector arcing under load.
causes.ur: Loose, kharab ya ghulmi se baitha MC4 connector load par chingaar maar raha hai.

causes.en: DC cable insulation chafed against metal or a sharp roof edge.
causes.ur: DC cable ki insulation metal ya sharp roof edge par kuchal gayi hai.

causes.en: Blowing a fuse or disconnecting a connector under DC load, which always arcs.
causes.ur: DC load par fuse udaana ya connector nikalna, jo hamesha chingaar maarta hai.

solutions.en: Rotate the DC switch to OFF and check for damaged cables, loose terminals or blown fuses, and poor contact.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF karein aur kharab cable, loose terminal ya uda hua fuse aur kamzor contact check karein.

solutions.en: Replace damaged cable and re-crimp terminals with a proper crimping tool; never reuse a burnt connector.
solutions.ur: Kharab cable badal dein aur terminals proper crimping tool se dobara crimp karein; jale hue connector dobara mat lagayein.

solutions.en: Rotate the DC switch to ON and clear the error via the App or LCD menu, then confirm it stays clear.
solutions.ur: DC switch ON karein aur App ya LCD menu se error clear karein, phir confirm karein error wapas nahi aaya.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: The AFCI arc detection function is switched off, so arc faults on the PV side will not be detected. A setting issue, not a fault.
meaning.ur: AFCI arc detection function band hai, is liye PV side ke arc fault detect nahi honge. Ye setting ki masla hai, fault nahi.

causes.en: Arc detection was left disabled during commissioning for a false-trip workaround.
causes.ur: Commissioning ke dauraan arc detection ko chhoot deya gaya tha taake jhalat trip na aaye.

causes.en: A settings reset reverted the option to disabled.
causes.ur: Settings reset hone se option dobara band ho gaya.

solutions.en: Enable the arc detection function via the App or the LCD menu.
solutions.ur: App ya LCD menu se arc detection function on karein.

solutions.en: After enabling, watch for false trips; if 088 appears without a real arc, have the connectors inspected.
solutions.ur: On karne ke baad nazar rakhein; agar asal arc ke baghair 088 aaye to connectors inspect karwane ko kahen.

solutions.en: If the error occurs repeatedly even with the function enabled, contact Sungrow Service Dept.
solutions.ur: Agar function on hone ke bawajood baar baar aaye to Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

title.ur: AC output current limit se upar (100)

meaning.en: The AC output current exceeded the upper limit. The inverter resumes automatically once the current drops back.
meaning.ur: AC output current upper limit se upar chala gaya. Current wapas normal hote hi inverter khud resume kar deta hai.

causes.en: Load surge from large appliances starting together.
causes.ur: Bare appliances ek saath start hone se load surge.

causes.en: Two inverters paralleled without correct master/slave configuration.
causes.ur: Do inverters bina sahi master/slave setting ke parallel kiye gaye.

solutions.en: The inverter resumes on its own once the output current falls below the protection value - wait first.
solutions.ur: Output current protection value se neeche girte hi inverter khud resume kar deta hai - pehle intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Reduce or stagger large loads so they do not all start together.
solutions.ur: Bare loads kam karein ya alag alag start karein taake sab ek saath na on hon.

solutions.en: If the fault still exists, contact Sungrow Service Dept.
solutions.ur: Agar fault phir bhi rahe to Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: The second, higher over-frequency threshold tripped - a worse frequency excursion than code 008.
meaning.ur: Dusra aur zyada high over-frequency level trigger hua - code 008 se zyada sakht frequency violation.

causes.en: Grid frequency beyond the permissible range, typically a generator-backed supply.
causes.ur: Grid frequency permissible range se bahar, aam tor par generator supply.

causes.en: Frequency protection parameter set too tight for the site.
causes.ur: Frequency protection parameter site ke liye bohat tight rakha gaya hai.

solutions.en: Check the actual grid frequency and log the reading and the time of the trip.
solutions.ur: Asli grid frequency check karke reading aur trip ka waqt note karein.

solutions.en: If the frequency exceeds the permissible range, ask the utility grid company for a solution.
solutions.ur: Agar frequency permissible range se upar ho to utility grid company se hal manga dein.

solutions.en: If the frequency is within the permissible range, contact Sungrow Service Dept.
solutions.ur: Agar frequency permissible range mein hai to Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: The second, lower under-frequency threshold tripped - a deeper frequency sag than code 009.
meaning.ur: Dusra aur neeche ka under-frequency level trigger hua - code 009 se zyada gehra frequency girawat.

causes.en: Overloaded generator or a very large motor start dragging frequency down.
causes.ur: Overloaded generator ya koi bohat bara motor start hokar frequency gira raha hai.

causes.en: Grid instability on a long or weak supply line.
causes.ur: Lambi ya kamzor supply line par grid unstable.

solutions.en: Check the actual grid frequency and log the reading and the time of the trip.
solutions.ur: Asli grid frequency check karke reading aur trip ka waqt note karein.

solutions.en: If the frequency is beyond the permissible range, ask the utility grid company for a solution.
solutions.ur: Agar frequency permissible range se bahar ho to utility grid company se hal manga dein.

solutions.en: If the frequency is within the permissible range, contact Sungrow Service Dept.
solutions.ur: Agar frequency permissible range mein hai to Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: Neither the PE terminal on the AC connection block nor the second PE terminal on the enclosure is reliably earthed.
meaning.ur: AC connection block ka PE terminal bhi na enclosure ka doosra PE terminal bhi reliably earth nahi hai.

causes.en: Earth wire not connected, or connected to a rusting/loose earth rod.
causes.ur: Earth wire judi hi nahi, ya zardast ya loose earth rod se judi hai.

causes.en: Earth conductor broken or a loose crimp at the AC block PE terminal.
causes.ur: Earth conductor toota hua ya AC block ke PE terminal par loose crimp.

solutions.en: With AC and PV isolated, check continuity from the AC block PE terminal to the earth rod with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate kar ke multimeter se AC block ke PE terminal se earth rod tak continuity check karein.

solutions.en: Re-terminate both PE terminals properly and tighten them to the specified torque.
solutions.ur: Dono PE terminals sahi tareeqe se dobara baithayein aur specified torque tak tighten karein.

solutions.en: If a proper earth is present and accessible and the fault persists, contact Sungrow Service Dept.
solutions.ur: Agar sahi earth mojood aur accessible hai aur fault phir bhi rahe to Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

title.ur: Bus par hardware level ka over-voltage (200)

meaning.en: The DC bus voltage exceeded the protective value and the hardware-level protection tripped. Serious - the power stage is being protected.
meaning.ur: DC bus voltage protective value se upar chala gaya aur hardware level protection trigger hui. Ye serious hai - power stage ko protect kiya ja raha hai.

causes.en: AC grid lost while the PV side kept feeding power into the bus.
causes.ur: AC grid chala gaya lekin PV side bus mein power deta raha raha.

causes.en: Bus voltage sensing fault giving a false over-voltage reading.
causes.ur: Bus voltage sensing fault jis se jhalat over-voltage reading aayi.

causes.en: Boost stage or DC link capacitor degradation.
causes.ur: Boost stage ya DC link capacitor ki quality ghatti.

solutions.en: Wait for the inverter to recover after the bus voltage falls - do not reset while the bus is still high.
solutions.ur: Bus voltage girne ke baad inverter ko recover hone dein - bus abhi high ho to reset na karein.

solutions.en: Check the AC breaker, anti-islanding relay and grid supply, which are the usual trigger for bus over-voltage.
solutions.ur: AC breaker, anti-islanding relay aur grid supply check karein, bus over-voltage ki asal wajah yahin hoti hai.

solutions.en: If the fault occurs repeatedly, contact Sungrow Service Dept.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar ho to Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: The internal DC bus voltage dropped below its normal operating level, so the inverter cannot run.
meaning.ur: Internal DC bus voltage apne normal operating level se neeche gir gaya, is liye inverter chal nahi sakta.

causes.en: Very low PV input - weak sunlight, so many strings are below the start-up voltage.
causes.ur: PV input bohat kam - dhoop kam hai, is liye bohat se strings start-up voltage se neeche hain.

causes.en: DC side fuses blown or a string connector open.
causes.ur: DC side ke fuses ude hue ya koi string connector khula.

solutions.en: Wait a moment for the inverter to recover; PV must reach the minimum start-up voltage.
solutions.ur: Thoda intezaar karein; PV ko minimum start-up voltage tak pohonchna zaruri hai.

solutions.en: Measure each string's open-circuit voltage in daylight and check the DC fuses one by one.
solutions.ur: Dopahar mein har string ka open-circuit voltage naalein aur DC fuses ek ek karke check karein.

solutions.en: Re-seat any open MC4 connector and replace blown fuses of the correct rating.
solutions.ur: Khula hua MC4 connector dobara baithayein aur sahi rating ke fuse badal dein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

title.ur: PV par hardware level current zyada (202)

meaning.en: PV1 or PV2 current exceeded the protective value at the hardware level - a hard protection trip.
meaning.ur: PV1 ya PV2 ka current hardware level par protective value se upar chala gaya - ye sakht protection trip hai.

causes.en: String current far above the MPPT input rating - too many modules in parallel.
causes.ur: String current MPPT input rating se bohat zyada - us MPPT par bohat zyada modules parallel.

causes.en: DC cable short circuit or insulation breakdown on that input.
causes.ur: Us input par DC cable short circuit ya insulation kharabi.

solutions.en: Turn the DC switch OFF, wait 10 minutes, then recount and re-verify the modules on that MPPT.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF karein, 10 minute wait karein, phir us MPPT ke modules dohrayein aur dobara verify karein.

solutions.en: Measure the string open-circuit and short-circuit current and compare with the datasheet values.
solutions.ur: String ka open-circuit aur short-circuit current naalein aur datasheet values se compare karein.

solutions.en: Contact Sungrow Service Dept if the fault occurs repeatedly - the hardware trip points to an internal limit.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar ho to Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein - hardware trip ka matlab internal limit ki kami hai.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

title.ur: PV input voltage bus se zyada (203)

meaning.en: PV input voltage rose above the internal bus voltage, which the inverter cannot convert safely.
meaning.ur: PV input voltage internal bus voltage se upar chala gaya, jo inverter mehfooz taur par convert nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: String voltage at or above the inverter's PV connection terminal limit.
causes.ur: String voltage inverter ke PV terminal limit par ya us se upar hai.

causes.en: String with too few modules for a MPPT, so the per-MPPT minimum is not met in cold weather.
causes.ur: MPPT par modules kam hain, is liye cold weather mein per-MPPT minimum poora nahi hota.

solutions.en: Check the functionality of the PV connection terminals as the manual directs.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq PV connection terminals ka kaam check karein.

solutions.en: Measure each string's open-circuit voltage on a cold, clear morning against the maximum DC input rating.
solutions.ur: Thande aur saaf subah har string ka open-circuit voltage naalein aur maximum DC input rating se compare karein.

solutions.en: Reconfigure the string with more modules or move it to a suitable MPPT - do not just raise the software limit.
solutions.ur: String mein modules zyada karke ya suitable MPPT par move karke dobara set karein - software limit sirf bara na karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: The measured PV input power and AC output power do not agree, indicating a measurement or switching-path fault.
meaning.ur: Napa hua PV input power aur AC output power ek se match nahi kar rahe, is ka matlab measurement ya switching path mein fault hai.

causes.en: Current or voltage sensor drift giving a false power reading.
causes.ur: Current ya voltage sensor ki ghalti se power reading jhalat.

causes.en: Partially disconnected string or a power stage device not switching correctly.
causes.ur: Adhoori disconnected string ya power stage device sahi se switch nahi ho raha.

solutions.en: Compare iSolarCloud PV power against the AC power and a clamp meter reading at the AC output.
solutions.ur: iSolarCloud ke PV power ko AC power aur AC output par clamp meter ki reading se compare karein.

solutions.en: With DC isolated, check every string terminal and MC4 for a partial or high-resistance connection.
solutions.ur: DC isolate kar ke har string terminal aur MC4 ko partial ya high-resistance connection ke liye check karein.

solutions.en: If the fault occurs repeatedly, contact Sungrow Service Dept.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar ho to Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: The PV1 current sampling channel reported an anomaly, so PV1 current cannot be trusted.
meaning.ur: PV1 current sampling channel ne anomaly report kiya, is liye PV1 current par bharosa nahi.

causes.en: PV1 current sensor or its harness damaged or loose.
causes.ur: PV1 current sensor ya uska harness kharab ya loose.

causes.en: Abnormal PV1 string current confusing the sampling circuit.
causes.ur: PV1 string ka abnormal current sampling circuit ko confuse kar raha hai.

solutions.en: Channel sampling anomaly - power cycle once: isolate AC and PV, wait 10 minutes, then restore.
solutions.ur: Channel sampling anomaly - ek baar power cycle karein: AC aur PV isolate karein, 10 minute wait karein, phir wapas on karein.

solutions.en: Measure PV1 string current with a DC clamp meter and compare with the app value.
solutions.ur: DC clamp meter se PV1 string current naalein aur app value se compare karein.

solutions.en: Contact Sungrow Service Dept if the fault persists - the sensor is not a field-repairable part.
solutions.ur: Agar fault rahe to Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein - sensor field mein theek nahi hota.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: The PV2 current sampling channel reported an anomaly, so PV2 current cannot be trusted.
meaning.ur: PV2 current sampling channel ne anomaly report kiya, is liye PV2 current par bharosa nahi.

causes.en: PV2 current sensor or its harness damaged or loose.
causes.ur: PV2 current sensor ya uska harness kharab ya loose.

causes.en: Abnormal PV2 string current confusing the sampling circuit.
causes.ur: PV2 string ka abnormal current sampling circuit ko confuse kar raha hai.

solutions.en: Channel sampling anomaly - power cycle once: isolate AC and PV, wait 10 minutes, then restore.
solutions.ur: Channel sampling anomaly - ek baar power cycle karein: AC aur PV isolate karein, 10 minute wait karein, phir wapas on karein.

solutions.en: Measure PV2 string current with a DC clamp meter and compare with the app value.
solutions.ur: DC clamp meter se PV2 string current naalein aur app value se compare karein.

solutions.en: Contact Sungrow Service Dept if the fault persists - the sensor is not a field-repairable part.
solutions.ur: Agar fault rahe to Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein - sensor field mein theek nahi hota.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: The leakage current sensor is not reporting sensibly, so the Riso/earth-fault protection cannot be trusted.
meaning.ur: Leakage current sensor theek report nahi kar raha, is liye Riso ya earth fault protection par bharosa nahi.

causes.en: Leakage current sensor module or its ribbon cable disconnected.
causes.ur: Leakage current sensor module ya uski ribbon cable nikal hui.

causes.en: Sensor module failed after a surge or water ingress.
causes.ur: Surge ya paas jaane ke baad sensor module fail ho gaya.

solutions.en: Contact Sungrow Service Dept for a sensor module replacement - do not bypass the leakage sensor.
solutions.ur: Sensor module replacement ke liye Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein - leakage sensor bypass na karein.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV before any internal check, and wait the full 10 minutes.
solutions.ur: Koi internal check karne se pehle AC aur PV isolate karein aur poore 10 minute wait karein.

solutions.en: Independently verify PV string insulation with an insulation tester so you are not blind to a real earth fault.
solutions.ur: Insulation tester se PV string ki insulation alag se verify karein taake asal earth fault chhoot na jaye.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: Every temperature sensor in the unit has failed, so the inverter has no thermal protection at all.
meaning.ur: Unit ke tamam temperature sensors fail ho gaye, is liye inverter ke paas koi bhi thermal protection nahi.

causes.en: All sensor harnesses unplugged during a past repair, or the sensor board failed.
causes.ur: Pichhli marammat mein tamam sensor harnesses nikal diye gaye, ya sensor board fail ho gaya.

causes.en: Shared sensor board supply rail failure taking all channels down together.
causes.ur: Shared sensor board ki supply rail failure ne tamam channels ko saath gira diya.

solutions.en: Keep the unit off or heavily ventilated, and do not run it unattended - there is no thermal cutoff.
solutions.ur: Unit band rakhein ya bohat ventilate karein, aur akela chhor ke na chalayein - koi thermal cutoff nahi hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, wait 10 minutes, then have a technician check the sensor board and harnesses.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karein, 10 minute wait karein, phir technician sensor board aur harnesses check kare.

solutions.en: Contact Sungrow Service Dept for a control board exchange - this is not a field-repairable fault.
solutions.ur: Control board exchange ke liye Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein - ye field mein theek nahi hota.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: The inverter could not read or write to its external memory. The inverter can still be connected to the grid normally.
meaning.ur: Inverter apni external memory se parh ya likh nahi paya. Inverter phir bhi normally grid se connected ho sakta hai.

causes.en: Intermittent power loss while saving settings corrupted the memory chip.
causes.ur: Settings save karte waqt bijli ka chalna jaldi band hona memory chip ko corrupt kar gaya.

causes.en: Memory chip solder joint or the board itself failing.
causes.ur: Memory chip ka solder joint ya board kharab ho raha hai.

solutions.en: Inverter can normally be connected to the grid - this is a warning, not a stop condition.
solutions.ur: Inverter normally grid se connect ho sakta hai - ye warning hai, rukne ki wajuh nahi.

solutions.en: Power on the inverter again; if the fault persists, contact Sungrow Service Dept.
solutions.ur: Inverter dobara power on karein; fault phir bhi rahe to Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein.

solutions.en: Re-save all settings from a clean App login and confirm they read back correctly.
solutions.ur: Saaf App login se tamam settings dobara save karein aur confirm karein wo theek parh aati hain.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: The ambient temperature sensor circuit reads open, so ambient temperature is not measured. A warning class item.
meaning.ur: Ambient temperature sensor ka circuit open read ho raha hai, is liye ambient temperature napa hi nahi ja rahi. Ye warning class ka item hai.

causes.en: Sensor cable disconnected or a connector pin backed out inside the unit.
causes.ur: Sensor ka cable nikal hua ya unit ke andar kisi connector ka pin nikal gaya.

causes.en: Sensor resistive element open with age or thermal cycling.
causes.ur: Sensor ka resistive element umar ya temperature cycles se open ho gaya.

solutions.en: Compare the reported ambient temperature against a thermometer at the site to see how far off it is.
solutions.ur: Site par thermometer se reported ambient temperature compare karein taake pata chale kitna farq hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, wait 10 minutes, then have a technician check the sensor connector seating.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karein, 10 minute wait karein, phir technician sensor connector ki seating check kare.

solutions.en: If the fault occurs repeatedly, contact Sungrow Service Dept.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar ho to Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

title.ur: Ambient temperature sensor short ho gaya (504)

meaning.en: The ambient temperature sensor reads short circuit, so ambient temperature is pinned to a wrong value.
meaning.ur: Ambient temperature sensor short circuit read kar raha hai, is liye ambient temperature galat value par atak gayi hai.

causes.en: Sensor cable chafed or pinched against a fan blade or heatsink.
causes.ur: Sensor ka cable fan blade ya heatsink se rub ho kar pinch ho gaya.

causes.en: Moisture tracking across the sensor board.
causes.ur: Sensor board par moisture track kar rahi hai.

solutions.en: Check the reported ambient temperature against a thermometer; a stuck value points to this sensor.
solutions.ur: Reported ambient temperature ko thermometer se check karein; atki hui value isi sensor ki nishani hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, wait 10 minutes, then inspect the sensor cable route near the fan for chafing.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karein, 10 minute wait karein, phir fan ke paas sensor cable ki routing rub hone ke liye dekhein.

solutions.en: If the fault occurs repeatedly, contact Sungrow Service Dept.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar ho to Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: The heatsink temperature sensor reads open, so the hottest point in the inverter is not being measured.
meaning.ur: Heatsink temperature sensor open read kar raha hai, is liye inverter ka sab se garam hissa napa hi nahi ja raha.

causes.en: Sensor harness disconnected during a fan or heatsink replacement.
causes.ur: Fan ya heatsink badalte waqt sensor harness nikal gaya.

causes.en: Sensor element open circuit from thermal cycling.
causes.ur: Sensor element temperature cycles se open ho gaya.

solutions.en: Do not rely on the heatsink temperature reading; watch for fault 036/037 instead as the real thermal warning.
solutions.ur: Heatsink temperature reading par bharosa na karein; asal thermal warning ke liye 036/037 ko dekhein.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, wait 10 minutes, then check the radiator sensor connector seating.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karein, 10 minute wait karein, phir radiator sensor connector ki seating check karein.

solutions.en: If the fault occurs repeatedly, contact Sungrow Service Dept.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar ho to Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

title.ur: Radiator temperature sensor short ho gaya (506)

meaning.en: The heatsink temperature sensor reads short circuit, so the temperature protection point is wrong.
meaning.ur: Heatsink temperature sensor short circuit read kar raha hai, is liye temperature protection ka point ghalat hai.

causes.en: Sensor cable crushed between the heatsink and the chassis.
causes.ur: Sensor ka cable heatsink aur chassis ke darmiyan daba hua hai.

causes.en: Water or dust ingress shorting the sensor terminals.
causes.ur: Paas ya dhool sensor terminals ko short kar rahi hai.

solutions.en: Treat heatsink temperature as unmeasured and rely on the 036/037 faults plus your own thermometer check.
solutions.ur: Heatsink temperature ko unmeasured samajhein aur 036/037 faults par apne thermometer check ke saath bharosa karein.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, wait 10 minutes, then check the sensor cable route and clean any debris.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karein, 10 minute wait karein, phir sensor cable ki routing check karein aur gand saaf karein.

solutions.en: If the fault occurs repeatedly, contact Sungrow Service Dept.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar ho to Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: The inverter has lost communication with the Sungrow meter. The inverter can still be connected to the grid normally - this is a monitoring loss, not a stop condition.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka Sungrow meter se communication khatam ho gaya hai. Inverter phir bhi normally grid se connected ho sakta hai - ye monitoring ka nuksan hai, rukne ki nahi.

causes.en: Meter power cable connections incorrect, so the meter is not powered or not powered correctly.
causes.ur: Meter ke power cable connections ghalat, is liye meter ko power nahi mil raha ya theek nahi mil raha.

causes.en: RS485 communication cable disconnected, loose or not correctly shielded/terminated.
causes.ur: RS485 communication cable nikal hua, loose ya sahi tareeqe se shield/terminate nahi hua.

solutions.en: Check whether the power cable connections of the meter are correct and re-terminate them.
solutions.ur: Check karein meter ke power cable connections sahi hain aur unhein dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Check whether the RS485 connection is correct, including A/B polarity and screen continuity.
solutions.ur: Check karein RS485 connection sahi hai ya nahi, A/B polarity aur screen continuity samet.

solutions.en: Power on the inverter again; if the fault persists, contact Sungrow Service Dept.
solutions.ur: Inverter dobara power on karein; fault phir bhi rahe to Sungrow Service Dept se rabta karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

title.ur: LED indicator jal hi nahi raha

meaning.en: The front LED indicator is completely dead - the unit gives no visual status at all.
meaning.ur: Front LED indicator bilkul band hai - unit koi bhi status nahi dikha raha.

causes.en: No DC input reaching the unit, so the indicator has nothing to show.
causes.ur: Unit tak DC input nahi pohanch raha, is liye indicator ke paas dikhane ko kuch nahi.

causes.en: DC input polarity reversed, so the unit powers up in a protected state.
causes.ur: DC input polarity ulta hai, is liye unit protected state mein power on hota hai.

solutions.en: Disconnect the AC circuit breaker first.
solutions.ur: Pehle AC circuit breaker disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Rotate the DC switch to OFF.
solutions.ur: DC switch ko OFF par le jayein.

solutions.en: Check the polarity of the DC input with a multimeter, then reconnect correctly.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se DC input ki polarity check karein, phir sahi tareeqe se dobara jodein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)

meaning.en: The green LED was on and then went out - the unit has left its normal running state or lost an input.
meaning.ur: Green LED on tha aur phir bujh gaya - unit apni normal running state chhor chuka hai ya koi input kho gaya hai.

causes.en: AC or DC input lost, or the inverter connection is loose.
causes.ur: AC ya DC input kho gaya, ya inverter connection loose hai.

causes.en: DC input voltage above the start-up voltage at the wrong polarity.
causes.ur: DC input voltage start-up voltage se upar hai magar polarity ghalat hai.

solutions.en: Disconnect the AC circuit breaker, then rotate the DC switch to OFF.
solutions.ur: AC circuit breaker disconnect karein, phir DC switch OFF par le jayein.

solutions.en: Check the inverter electrical connection as described in the manual's electrical connection section.
solutions.ur: Manual ke electrical connection section mein bataye tareeqe se inverter ke connection check karein.

solutions.en: Check whether the DC input voltage exceeds the inverter start-up voltage.
solutions.ur: Check karein DC input voltage inverter ki start-up voltage se zyada hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If all the above conditions are OK, contact Sungrow.
solutions.ur: Agar upar wali sab conditions theek hain to Sungrow se rabta karein.

source.title: SG2-8K G2 Premium User Manual - 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (Error List V1.3, author 钟明)
